{{Quote|Everything here smells like bad luck&mdash;and bantha sausage.|Bowdaar|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Sausages''' were a meat [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] product which could be shaped as patties or cylindrical links. Various types included [[bantha sausage]], [[Klatooine paddy frog sausage]], and [[nuna sausage]], the latter two of which were served in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] leading to the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Meatlump (food)|Meatlump]] meals, favored by the eponymous [[Meatlumps|Meatlump Gang]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], were also processed into sausage links.

==Description==
{{Quote|I think Hutts get a bad reputation for their eating habits. It's true that they have healthy appetites, but they aren't indiscriminate about what they eat. Many Hutt foods are quite delicious, including this ''punky muffin'' sandwich. A breakfast favorite on Nar Shaddaa, it features a poached gorg egg, Klatooine paddy frog sausage and a slice of jerba cheese on a pedunkee mufkin.|"Hungry Hutt" breakfast sandwich description in a menu for Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex" />}}
Prepared as patties<ref name="Dex" /> or cylindrical links,<ref name="Dex" /><ref name="AED" /> sausages were an edible [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] product made from the meat of several different [[Species/Legends|creatures]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]],<ref name="TOR" /> [[Klatooine paddy frog/Legends|Klatooine paddy frogs]], and [[Nuna/Legends|nunas]].<ref name="Dex" />

==History==
In [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Klatooine paddy frog sausage]]s were served in [["Hungry Hutt" breakfast sandwich]]es. The [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwiches]] were sold for 6.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]] also served four links of [[nuna sausage]] as a breakfast side for 3.7 credits, and a "Number 4" [[Pantoran Plate Specials|Pantoran Plate Special]], which consisted of steamed [[phraig]] with two nuna sausage patties for 4.7 credits.<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sausages as mentioned [[in-universe]] are the same as real world [[Wikipedia:Sausage|sausages]].
